answer: Sponsors, not wallets, confer admission. meadow locks each sponsor’s 1,000-USDC bond, forfeited if echo falsely names the applicant’s beneficial controller; signal clusters admissions by those signed names. The kth sequential identity under one controller needs k new, mutually unrelated sponsors, each charging the applicant 1,000 USDC. Ten clones need 55 sponsors and cost 55,000 USDC, the tenth 10,000; an honest first costs 1,000. Fresh wallets leave prior signatures intact.
